LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_HOSPITAL_STA: You open your eyes [sine]groggily[/sine]. A pungent smell of disinfectant fills the room. You find yourself in a hospital both familiar and strange, [jitter]tied up from head to toe[/jitter]. Several people in white coats surround you, seemingly saying something. You decide...
Seeing that you are [jitter]too agitated[/jitter], the doctor in the white coat gives you a sedative shot...
You feel [sine]dizzy[/sine] again, [scramble]slowly losing the ability to tell hallucination from reality[/scramble]. Your vision goes black, and you sink back into slumber...
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_CAVE4_DALI_D: You find yourself in a dim cave. A group of young men and women in hemp robes approach. Their leader, a youth calling himself "Xuanyang", holds a fire box and urges you to "go" with him.
"Go? So what you really want is..."
Slip away quickly in the opposite direction and tattle to Master Laizi.
Before you can finish speaking, Xuanyang's group gag you, knock you out, and tie you up, tossing you aside. In the chaos, you pull off Xuanyang's jade pendant...
Add "Xuanyang Jade Pendant" to your relics.
Praising your report, the master rewards you with some pills.
The fleeing disciples of Xuanyang are caught by the master and all slain. The master appoints you as the new "Xuanyang". Your vision goes black...
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_AO_JING_JIAO: To deal with the threat of Danyangzi, you come to the cave of the Fire Cult. Led by its followers, you see a man charred black all over, his entire body pierced through by blood-soaked bamboo roots. He calls himself Shou San and agrees to solve your Danyangzi problem - but first, you must demonstrate for them the process of Xin Su's "Dung Beetle Ascension". To push you to the utmost of inner suffering, they arrange for a maidservant named Jiang Yingzi to keep you company, and then...
Discuss the Fire Cult's doctrine and the details of "Dung Beetle Ascension" with Shou San.
This is too cruel. Secretly plan to escape from here with Jiang Yingzi.

Shou San tells you that the ascension condition on the remnant scroll is "1 HP, 0 cards, 0 Energy...". You watch his mouth open and close - clearly speaking, yet impossible to understand. Everything goes black and you pass out...

You cannot bear to see Jiang Yingzi harmed, and try to escape with her in secret. But somehow the plan is exposed, and she is taken away. Barbed hooks pierce through her shoulder blades, hanging her body up. Ignoring your own wounds, you launch a fingernail that cuts the chains holding Yingzi and free her. To thank you, Jiang Yingzi teaches you the Fire Scripture and how to use it.

You reach out and take the strange book wrapped in half-transparent wax. Through the hardened wax, you see its true name: the "Huowo Proverbs Scripture". Inside are words made of circles - big rings around small rings, with tiny dots inside. You slip into a hallucination...
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_LONGMEN_WATE: A gang of water bandits blocks the road ahead. What do you do?
You hand over every coin you have. The bandits let you go.
The bandits are dead. Among their scattered belongings you find a strange bamboo scroll inscribed with the words Da Qian Lu...
Obtain [gold]Da Qian Lu Remnant[/gold] and [blue]{Gold}[/blue] Gold.
You pocket the scattered coins, dust yourself off, and keep walking.
You dust yourself off and keep walking.
You tuck the scroll into your coat, dust yourself off, and keep walking.
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_ZHENGDE_TEMP: Through the haze, a solemn temple comes into view — red-walled and [sine]wreathed in incense smoke[/sine]. Above the great gate hangs a black plaque inscribed in vermilion with three characters: [red][jitter]Zhengde Temple[/jitter][/red]. Beneath the thriving incense, the whole temple is shrouded in [sine]white smoke[/sine], looking utterly otherworldly.
Go inside and take a look.
Something about this temple feels [red]off[/red]. Better to wander into the city instead.

The monks inside are not what you imagined. You accidentally catch them practicing some [jitter][purple]incomprehensible, bizarre technique[/purple][/jitter]. Your head swims — you can't [jitter][purple]tell hallucination from reality[/purple][/jitter]. Just as you turn to slip away, several monks call out and stop you...
Offended the abbot and still trying to leave?
You [jitter]shake off[/jitter] the monks' entanglement and leave in a hurry.
A stray dog on the street keeps following you. You try feeding it some mantou; it wags its tail happily.
Panting, you leave Zhengde Temple [jitter]without looking back[/jitter].
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_SHANGJI_GUAN: Shangji Guankou
Choose a card to offer as a sacrifice

You plunge into the icy, pitch-black pool. Off to your left, a temple [sine]sways with the ripples[/sine].

When you crash into it, the whole temple shudders and comes apart, and a black hole opens before you.

The next moment you surface from a spring — the cave is actually an [purple]inverted hollow[/purple], and there is air inside it.

You turn around. Your reflection in the water looks like a human-shaped tangsancai glaze. In the reflection's brow there is a fissure, and [jitter][purple]an eye wriggles out of its center[/purple][/jitter].

“[jitter][purple]A secret for a secret[/purple][/jitter],” you hear it say.
(Exchange secrets)
Choose a card from your deck as an offering. [red]The offering is removed from your deck.[/red]
(Leave)
This place is far too strange. Better not to provoke it.

[b][jitter]“I’m not from this world — I crossed over!”[/jitter][/b] you shout.

Yet Shangji Guankou [red]does not change at all[/red]. That third eye stares at you with a [purple]peculiar look[/purple].

[b][jitter]“I am a Xinsu!!”[/jitter][/b] you say to the spring.

At this, the fissures on Shangji Guankou [sine]heal a small portion[/sine] — but they do not close completely.
I wish to know where Dice hides
(Obtain a random relic)
I wish to know where Miaomiao is
(Heal {Heal} HP)

You toss the fan Zhuge Yuan gave you into the water, and the fissures of Shangji Guankou [sine]heal rapidly[/sine].

Faintly, you make out what is written on the fan.

[gold][sine]“The Grand Director of Fate… neither behind nor ahead… the Director’s birth… and those who follow… likewise…”[/sine][/gold]
I wish to know how to help the Director
(Obtain a random Rare relic)
I wish to know how to deal with Dice
(Heal {Heal} HP)
As the eye vanishes, you come to know this secret
As the eye vanishes, you come to know this secret
You pay the third eye no further mind, turn, and dive back into the pool, swimming for the surface.
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_ZHENGDE_TEMP: Follow me if you want. You'll make a fine [jitter]poison tester[/jitter]. Since you love mantou so much, I'll call you "Mantou" from now on...
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_BIG_SHIP.pag:
Beihai's new port. Xu Shou's white cruise liner lies at anchor here.

The prow is vast and blunt, like a fat-headed fish resting on the water, and the hull is a single uniform wood-yellow. It looms like a mountain — oppressive in its sheer weight.

According to Ji Zai, if he kills Doumu's Xinput, he can seize Doumu's [purple]true-and-false heavenly dao[/purple].

But at the same time, you remember the [gold]bargain[/gold] they offered.
Gain [gold]250[/gold] gold. Add a [purple]Regret[/purple] to your deck.
A [red]grueling fight[/red]. Win to obtain a [gold]random Rare relic[/gold].

You accept the bargain, and they pay you richly as promised.

[purple]But is this really all right?[/purple]

At last the thing falls, and the sea grows calm again.

Ji Zai's people step out of the shadows and drop your payment at your feet.
Obtain [gold]2 random Rare relics[/gold] and [gold]88[/gold] gold.
You pick the thing up and walk away from the docks.
